captions.detailed: A retractable soft-top sunroof cassette featuring a rectangular dark grey aluminum frame with integrated side guide rails. A flexible black canvas panel spans the central opening, attached at the rear to a cylindrical roller drum. The front edge of the canvas is guided by two light grey prismatic sliding shoes that travel linearly along the side tracks, allowing the roof to open and close smoothly.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a retractable canvas soft-top sunroof cassette. It should feature a rectangular outer frame with side guide channels, a cylindrical roller drum mounted at the rear, a flat soft-top canvas panel, and light grey sliding shoes on each side that slide along the frame's rails to retract the panel.
captions.factory: Construct the outer frame using a combination of thin boxes to form the side channels, front, and rear frame borders. Model the rear roller drum as a cylinder. Create the flat canvas cover as a thin, wide box. Finally, construct the sliding guide shoes on each side using small rectangular boxes, positioning them to fit within the side channels of the main frame.
